thin_slices_provide_value_learning_or_ri.justification: All 3 increments align with this: Increment 1 reduces risk (validates Foundry API) and provides value (basic mob coordination). Increment 2 provides high value (strategic behavior). Increment 3 provides value (convenience features).

slices_do_not_need_all_functionality.justification: Increment 1 delivers mob coordination without strategies. Increment 2 adds strategies without templates. Each is useful independently while building toward complete feature set.

not_every_increment_must_be_user_visible.modification: However, for this project, ALL increments will be user-visible and valuable to GMs. Increment 1 includes both API validation (learning/risk reduction) AND basic mob creation + attack (user value). We're combining foundational work with user features rather than doing pure infrastructure increments.

some_slices_may_be_architectural.justification: Increment 1's Foundry API mapping is architectural/foundational, but we're bundling it with user-facing mob creation to ensure each increment delivers both technical foundation and user value.

strategy_summary.increment_philosophy: Each increment de-risks technical unknowns while delivering end-to-end user value
key_principles: Validate Foundry API early (Increment 1) to reduce highest technical risk
Deliver core user value (mob coordination) in Increment 1 to prove concept
Add strategic depth (targeting behaviors) in Increment 2 for differentiation
Polish with convenience features (templates, editing) in Increment 3
Each increment is demonstrable, testable, and independently valuable
Dependencies flow naturally: API → Basic Mobs → Strategies → Advanced Features

increment_1.name: Foundational Integration + Basic Mob
increment_1.goal: Validate Foundry API and deliver core mob coordination
increment_1.value_proposition: GM can group minions and execute coordinated attacks
increment_1.risk_mitigation: Validates proprietary Foundry API works for mob coordination
stories_included: All Map Foundry API stories (8 stories)
increment_1.acceptance: GM selects minions, groups them into mob, clicks one minion, all perform melee attack

increment_2.name: Strategy System
increment_2.goal: Add intelligent targeting and tactical behavior
increment_2.value_proposition: Mobs use different strategies for tactical combat
increment_2.dependencies: Requires Increment 1 foundation (Foundry API + basic mobs)
increment_2.acceptance: GM assigns strategy to mob, mob selects targets based on strategy, executes appropriate attack type

increment_3.name: Advanced Mob Management
increment_3.value_proposition: Easy mob management and reusable templates
increment_3.acceptance: GM can modify mob membership, spawn mobs from templates, reuse mob configurations

rationale.why_3_increments: Natural breakpoints: 1) Foundation + proof of concept, 2) Strategic depth, 3) Convenience. Each increment roughly 4-8 stories, manageable scope.
rationale.why_api_first: Highest technical risk. If Foundry API doesn't support required features, we learn early before building dependent functionality.
rationale.why_bundle_api_with_value: Pure infrastructure increment provides no user feedback. Combining API validation with basic mob feature proves the concept works end-to-end.
rationale.why_strategies_second: Requires stable foundation but delivers high differentiation value. Separating from basic mobs allows focused testing of targeting logic.
rationale.why_advanced_features_last: Lowest risk, highest polish. Can be deferred if timeline pressure. Core value already delivered in Increments 1 & 2.
